# plane-dsh-plugin
简体中文
A native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that quietly turns meaningful coding work into Plane project
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that quietly turns meaningful coding work into Plane project updates.
The plugin recognizes tasks, bugs, decisions, ideas, risks, milestones, plans, progress, and complet
ions during an agent session. It writes events to a local SQLite outbox first, synchronizes them to
Plane asynchronously, and exposes a global floating panel for inspecting and updating work items.

> [!NOTE]
> This project is an early release. The storage and synchronization paths are extensively
tested, but DSH and its external plugin APIs are still evolving.
## Features

- DSH-native Cordis host and browser client plugin in one installable bundle.
- Eight agent tools fo

r project discovery, binding, capture, and review.
- Durable local SQLite outbox with idempotency, r

etries, leases, and crash recovery.
- Asynchronous synchronization to Plane without blocking the mai

n agent task.
- Incremental active-item context instead of repeating a full project snapshot every t

urn.
- Floating Plane-style panel with status filters, optimistic updates, and sync health.
- Manual
project switcher for DSH's global overlay, including duplicate-name disambiguation and stale-respon

se protection.
- Plane API keys resolved through DSH credentials and never written to the plugin dat

tection.
- Plane API keys resolved through DSH credentials and never written to the plugin database.
## Requirements

- Node.js 22.19 or newer.
- pnpm available on `PATH` for DSH plugin management.
- A recent `@deepsee
k-ai/dsh` release with external bundles, credentials, tools, client slots, and Typert remote support

.
- A Plane workspace and API key.

Useful commands:
| Command | Purpose |

| `pnpm build` | Build internal packages and assemble the public bundle. |

rify the package contract, and run tests. |

|
`pnpm run pack:check` | Inspect the publishable tarball contract in a temporary directory. |
## Privacy and security

- Source code, terminal output, and full transcripts are not stored by the plugin.
- The Plane API k

ey is resolved per operation through DSH credentials.
- Local project metadata and the outbox are st

ored in SQLite at `~/.dsh/plugins/ambient-project/ambient.sqlite` by default.
- Before reporting a v
ulnerability, read SECURITY.md.
